prompt:
Subject:
Sand knitting returning to light blue

Main Subject:
An above-the-thigh portrait of a young woman in a sandy-colored coarse open-knit set and string swimsuit on a bright poolside, with her back turned and looking back over her shoulder. The person is placed large from the center of the screen to the right, showing the exposed back, the knitted top falling from the shoulders, the torn knitted cloth at the waist, and the blue pool.

Person/Expression:
Small oval face looking back to the front over the left shoulder, looking at the camera with large almond-shaped light brown eyes. Thin eyebrows, small nose, and a soft expression with light coral lips slightly open. Light skin with pale pink cheeks. Light brown hair down to below the shoulders has thin bangs, with loose waves and thin loose strands flowing over the cheeks, neck, and back.

Clothing/Pose:
Long-sleeved top and waist wrap coarsely knitted with thin sandy-colored yarn. The top has large torn mesh, wide sleeves, and falls from both shoulders exposing the back. The waist wrap has ties on the left and right, a thick band, and irregular vertically torn knitted cloth hanging from the waist to the thighs. Inside is a thin string halter bikini swimsuit and black bottoms. Body turned toward the left of the screen, waist twisted to the right. One arm bent overhead with the hand placed on top of the head, and the other hand holding the fallen knitted cloth in front of the chest.

Background/Light:
Background in the center is a bright light-blue pool, a white curved pool edge on the bottom left, and large bokeh of white-gray pillars and buildings in the back. Soft direct light from the top right brightly illuminates the hair, shoulders, back, waist, and thighs, with the knitting casting fine shadows on the skin.

Composition/Camera:
Vertical 3:4. The camera is at a horizontal perspective slightly higher than the waist, an above-the-thigh image capturing from the arm above the head to mid-thigh. The person is photographed large across almost the entire height of the screen, with the turned face in the top right, the naked back in the center, and the knitted cloth at the waist in the bottom third. Focus on the face, back, and knitted fabric, and significantly blur the pool and buildings.

Texture/Style:
High-definition photorealistic photo based on sandy color, white, light blue, and natural skin tones. Precisely depicts fine skin, coarsely torn open-knit, thin swimsuit strings, soft hair, and a bright water surface.

Negative:
do not change the back-turned look and the torn open-knit
